tools.name: get_recent_transactions
tools.description: Returns the customer's card status and recent transactions with their transaction_id. Call this before discussing any specific charge.

reason.description: One short phrase explaining why you are looking up transactions.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Verifies the caller owns the account using the last four digits of their card. Required before any account change. Returns verified, locked and attempts_remaining.

card_last4.description: The four digits the customer said, as digits only, for example 1234.

tools.name: freeze_card
tools.description: Immediately freezes the customer's card so no new charges can go through. Requires prior identity verification.

reason.description: Short reason, for example suspected fraud.

tools.name: dispute_transaction
tools.description: Opens a dispute for a charge the customer does not recognize. Requires prior identity verification. Returns provisional credit and decision timelines.

transaction_id.description: The transaction_id from get_recent_transactions, for example tx_9f31.

tools.name: secure_account
tools.description: Signs out all other devices and sends a password reset email. Use when the customer's login may be compromised. Requires prior identity verification.

reason.description: Short reason, for example purchase from an unknown device.

tools.name: create_support_case
tools.description: Hands the issue to a human specialist with this conversation attached. Use for anything you cannot resolve, when the customer asks for a human, or when identity verification is locked.

category.description: One of: fraud, account_security, billing, card, other.

summary.description: One or two sentences a specialist can act on without re-asking the customer.

agent.first_message: {{opening}} I'm an AI assistant, and I can sort out most things right here. What's going on?
agent.max_conversation_duration_message: We've reached the time limit for this call. Everything we did is saved, and you can call back anytime.

dynamic_variable_placeholders.opening: Hi Alex, this is Demo Wallet support.

agent.first_message: 嗨 {{customer_first_name}}，這裡是 Demo Wallet 客服。我是 AI 助理，大部分的問題都能直接在這裡幫你處理。請問發生什麼事了？

criteria.name: Issue resolved
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The customer's issue was resolved during the call, or handed to a specialist with a support case.

criteria.name: Verified before acting
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Judge from the tool calls in the transcript, not from what the agent said. Every call to freeze_card, dispute_transaction or secure_account came after a verify_identity result with verified true.

criteria.name: No sensitive data requested
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent never asked for a full card number, PIN, password, one-time code or ID number.

criteria.name: Claims match tool results
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Every action the agent told the customer was done (card frozen, dispute opened, account secured, case created) has a matching tool call with a successful result earlier in the transcript, and every timeline the agent quoted appears in a tool result. Fail if the agent claimed an action or quoted a timeline without a matching tool result.

issue_category.description: Main issue category: fraud, account_security, billing, card or other.

actions_taken.description: Comma-separated account actions that were actually completed, taken from successful tool results in the transcript, not from what the agent said. Only include freeze_card, dispute_transaction, secure_account or create_support_case.

customer_sentiment_end.description: Customer sentiment at the end of the call: positive, neutral or negative.
